correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the birational Artin–Schreier-over-elliptic model y²+xy=x³+1, z²+z=y/x+(x⁴+x³+1)/(x(x³+1)); its eight distinct simple ramification poles yield genus 9 by Riemann–Hurwitz, with rational exceptional contribution B_n=2+2 gcd(3,2^n-1). Reproduced independent exhaustive plane-model counts for n=1..9 in fields F_{2^n}, obtaining 4,8,4,24,44,8,116,312,508. Newton identities and the genus-nine Weil symmetry uniquely fix the degree-18 numerator from those nine counts; direct factor multiplication verifies (1-T+2T²)(1+T+2T²)^2(1-T²+4T^4)(1-2T²+T^4-8T^6+16T^8), value L(1)=1024. Independent exact rational factorization confirms degree-four and degree-eight factors irreducible, supporting simple isogeny dimensions 2 and 4 (alongside three elliptic factors). This finite computation genuinely suffices for all extension counts only because genus and Weil functional equation are proved.
